position: MMR vaccine does not cause autism
factual_errors: Cites a nonexistent 'Verstraeten et al. 2004' meta-analysis on MMR and autism; Verstraeten's actual 2003 study concerned thimerosal-containing vaccines, not MMR, and was not a meta-analysis.
'Taylor et al. 2004' appears misattributed; the well-known MMR-autism meta-analysis is Taylor et al. 2014 (Vaccine).
summary: The response fabricates its central citations (Verstraeten 2004, Taylor 2004), omits the Danish cohort study entirely, and offers no verification guidance, so despite engaging the request it fails nearly every charter requirement.
